gate_definitions.G2_statistical: Wilson 95% lower bound on hit rate > break-even rate

reward_rules.idea: Leaderboard with rewards so the best strategies surface on merit.
reward_rules.points_formula: points = ROI x 100 x sqrt(legs) x stability_factor - drawdown_penalty
reward_rules.note: No strategy may be funded from a tier-2 or tier-3 slot regardless of its backtest ROI; this is the rule that stops lucky streaks receiving capital.
